regions.region: title, graphical abstract, and abstract in the upper and middle page
regions.finding: The graphical abstract is a generic present-paper summary of Fe-catalyzed dienolate generation followed by direct trapping or isomerization/trapping; classified as a general scheme, not an individual experiment.
Generic alpha/gamma electrophilic trapping of a 1,3-dienolate, presented as introductory chemistry associated with cited background literature; classified as a general scheme.
Background statements about prior protonation, alkylation, and aldol reactions lack experiment-specific structures/conditions and were not expanded into additional records.

unresolved: Graphical-abstract R groups and branch-specific electrophile conditions are generic.
No SI file is supplied or explicitly associated; the main-text statement of SI availability does not establish an association.

regions.region: Table 1 reaction diagram, seven rows, and footnotes in the upper half
regions.finding: Fourteen independent substrate-scope experiments extracted: seven acyl-chloride Conditions A records and seven allyl-carboxylate Conditions B records. Shared scale, electrophile amount, temperature program, isolated-yield basis, and crude-1H-NMR ratio basis were applied to each appropriate row.
The explicitly prior-reported reference-5 Z-6a result (61%) was classified as a literature example and kept separate from current Table 1 entry 1 (68%).

regions.region: Figure 1 NOE drawings and surrounding discussion in the lower half
regions.finding: NOE evidence supports the source's Z/E labels for 6a and 7a but is not an additional reaction; it remains linked through same-page evidence to the corresponding records.

unresolved: The prior 61% result omits electrophile amount, trapping duration, yield basis, atmosphere, workup, and purification.
Table 1 omits atmosphere, workup, and purification; candidate structures and stereochemistry remain unverified.

regions.region: Table 2 reaction diagram, eight rows, and footnotes in the upper half
regions.finding: Sixteen independent substrate-scope experiments extracted: eight Pd(PPh3)4/allylic-acetate Conditions C records and eight CuI/allylic-bromide Conditions D records, including row-specific R groups, isolated yields, and selectivity.

regions.region: Table 2 entry 8 Conditions D ratio cell and footnote d
regions.finding: The table dash was preserved as a source marker; footnote d says the other isomer was not isolated, so no numeric E/Z ratio was invented.

The Z-7h crystal structure and narrative discussion support Table 2 identities/selectivity but do not constitute additional reactions. The final paragraph begins the proposed rationale continued on page 4.

unresolved: Table 2 omits atmosphere, workup, and purification.
Entry 8 Conditions D has no numeric selectivity ratio; candidate structures and stereochemistry remain unverified.

regions.region: Scheme 2 at upper left and its explanatory prose
regions.finding: Proposed Z/E dienolate isomerization through anti-allylic MgCl and syn-allylic metal species; classified as mechanism, not an observed experiment.

Three distinct room-temperature trapping/control experiments extracted: acetyl chloride to 6a (70% NMR, Z/E 96/4), allyl acetate without Pd to 6a (37% NMR, E/Z 76/24), and Pd(PPh3)4/allyl acetate to 7a (71% NMR, Z/E 69/31).

regions.region: conclusion, acknowledgements, and Supporting Information Available notice
regions.finding: No additional experiment is reported. The notice says procedures and spectra are available online, but no SI file is supplied here, so SI association remains unestablished.

unresolved: Scheme 3 omits scale, post-addition duration, atmosphere, workup, and purification.
Generic mechanism structures and all candidate stereochemical structures remain unverified.
